description: This file contains tests for detecting legacy, non-throwing FileHandle read API usage in Swift source files within a project. It dynamically searches for Swift files under the 'Sources' directory, strips comments and string literals from source code to avoid false positives, and throws an error if outdated FileHandle APIs are found.

classes.name: FileHandleLegacyAPIGuardTests
classes.description: A test suite that checks for the usage of legacy non-throwing FileHandle read APIs across the project's source files.

methods.name: `sources avoid legacy non throwing file handle read AP is`
methods.description: Main test function that scans source files for deprecated API usage.

methods.name: swiftFiles
methods.description: Recursively collects all Swift files under a given directory.

methods.name: stripCommentsAndStrings
methods.description: Removes comments and string literals from source code to prevent false positives when searching for specific API usage.
